source.geography: ABS ASGS Edition 3 Local Government Areas 2025
source.note: Seeded from ABS LGA 2025 for Western Australia, excluding statistical special-purpose codes (137 LGAs). Home-prepared food for sale generally requires registration with local government Environmental Health.

unincorporated.label: WA Department of Health regulated sites
unincorporated.notes: Most food businesses register with local government. Department of Health prescribed fees apply to DoH-regulated sites only.

councils.name: Armadale Council
councils.notes: Food business registration with City of Armadale Environmental Health. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Belmont Council
councils.notes: Food business registration required. Contact Environmental Health for home-based kitchen advice.

councils.name: Canning Council
councils.notes: Register with City of Canning Environmental Health. Home kitchen food for sale requires registration.

councils.name: Cockburn Council
councils.notes: Register home-based food businesses with Environmental Health before selling food.

councils.name: Fremantle Council
councils.notes: Food premises registration with City of Fremantle Environmental Health. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Joondalup Council
councils.notes: Register with Environmental Health before operating. Home-based businesses contact council for kitchen assessment.

councils.name: Mandurah Council
councils.notes: Register food premises with City of Mandurah before operating. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Melville Council
councils.notes: Food business registration with City of Melville Environmental Health. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Perth Council
councils.notes: Home-based food for sale requires registration. Online application via ePathway. Inspection fees apply by risk rating.

councils.name: Rockingham Council
councils.notes: Register with City of Rockingham Environmental Health before selling food from home. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Stirling Council
councils.notes: Register food businesses with City of Stirling Environmental Health. Home kitchen registration required for food prepared for sale.

councils.name: Subiaco Council
councils.notes: Food business registration with City of Subiaco Environmental Health. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Swan Council
councils.notes: Register food premises with City of Swan Environmental Health before operating. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Victoria Park Council
councils.notes: Register with Town of Victoria Park Environmental Health Services. Home-based food businesses contact Environmental Health before operating.

councils.name: Wanneroo Council
councils.notes: Food business registration with local Environmental Health. Home kitchen requires registration when food is prepared for sale.
